_comment: Aggregated SxS Literature Review Quality verdict (App. F.3 protocol). Both runs agreed that paper-orc has the stronger lit review.
consistency: Both runs agreed; positional bias did not flip the verdict.
decisive_driver: Citation coverage: 57 vs 26 unique citations in Intro + Related Work, with paper-orc including the foundational human-subjects methodological anchors (Kaiser, Horn, Tucker, Couch & Keniston, Crowne & Marlowe, Vandenberg & Lance, Meredith) that the human-authored original omits. For a paper whose central argument is that the LLM-personality literature has skipped the standard validation toolkit, citing that toolkit explicitly is load-bearing.
secondary_drivers: Parallel-structured Related-Work subsections (overview → SOTA → limitation → bridge) provide more explicit scaffolding than the original's '\paragraph{Our contribution}' format.
7-bullet itemised contribution list at the end of the Introduction is sharper than the original's prose-only positioning.
Explicit silicon-sample stakeholder framing in the Introduction.
ACL-canonical \citep / \citet usage vs the original's mixed \cite style.
